propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion runs exhaust the bounded request budget with zero CriterionBank entries, violating the incremental-banking contract and raising CompletionRecoveryError instead of evidence-backed PASS/FAIL.

Pydantic AI executes model response tool batches concurrently, causing prompt-only serialization instructions to fail in enforcing one governed action per response, deferring all record calls until budget exhaustion.

The completion policy wrapper at the build_agent_kwargs seam atomically claims one governed repository action per run_step, counts unique evidence responses per criterion, and provisionally banks met=false on the third evidence response if still unbanked, restoring the bounded-progress contract.

System-prompt finite guidance replaced subjective evidence-sufficiency conditions with explicit affirmative loop: process manifest ids in order, use prefetched evidence first, select one repository action per response, commit through record_criterion_verdict, advance on success or third response.

The held-out behavioral oracle reproduced zero-bank baseline (0/3 trials bounded success), passed with policy enabled (≥2/3 trials), and regressed to 0/3 when policy attachment was disabled, proving the fix mechanism against the original defect.
